'''obi-wan-wonder Death Star Dnasty''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[obi-wan-wonder]]
* '''Published:''' 22 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)|CC-D-cloudcityeastplatformdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Cloud City East Platform (Docking B.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

this deck has a well guarded death star with many strong ground forces.

(look at my other rebel deck, Hoth Heaven)

== Strategy ==

Death star +

superlaser +

death star gunners +

Comence primary ignition - thees are for generating force, and bowing planets up.

Boba Fett, dark jedi light sabr +

Slave 1 - theese are here to help control planets, battles at planets, and transportation for boba so he can go down to the ground and kill people and force drain.

Prince Xizor, dark jedi lightsaber +

Guri, dark jedi lightsaber +

the Stinger - the same as boba but a better team.

IG-88, pulse cannon, jetpack+

Zuckuss, snare rifle +

Myo +

Dr. Evazen & Ponda Baba +

Tonnika sisters +

Bossk +

Dengar +

Wuher - they are all my ground forces. they are for deploying on the rebel base to steal thngs, capture people, force drain, and to stop them from moving. Dr. E and ponda are aso to give power to the conquest if i need it.

Gen. Veers, temp. 1, antipersonel laser can +

Corporal avirak, speeder bike, can. - they are to help transport my groundforces safely, to force drain and to add alot of power in battles.

Ds-61-2, Scimmitar 2, proton bombs - bombing stuff.

Captain Piett +

DS-61-4 +

Danz Borin +

Boba Fett w. blaster rifle +

Conquest, turbolaser battery - control planets. all the pilots add to he power. they are also reserve ground troops if i really need them.

Admiral Motti +

Vader +

Admiral Ozzel - protecting the death star and adding to commence primary ignition.

Effects- you basicly know what they are for.

This deck is made to wipe out rebel forces. most of my ground forces have high ability and are for excessive force draining. i try to get prince xizor out with guri as quickly as possible because he is pretty hard to kill wih Guri and keeps down attrition.
